$comment: Sprite-type defaults for the weapon family. Merged into every weapon brief by scripts/sprites/load-brief.ts before Zod validation. Per-leaf scalars from the brief win; arrays REPLACE rather than append. A brief can override `centerToleranceX` without restating `derive: true`, etc. Use `$`-prefixed metadata keys here — `stripMetaKeys` in the loader only drops `$`-prefixed properties before merge; underscore-prefixed keys would survive into the merged brief and be rejected by the strict schema.

sensors.$comment: diagonalToleranceDeg is a misnomer: it controls the half-width of the acceptance window around the requested principal-axis orientation (vertical here, diagonal elsewhere). With 64px-target outputs the 4x4 grid model can still drift a few degrees from dead 90°, so we accept ±5° around vertical. Sensor tightening is a separate axis from prompt strictness — the prompt still asks for 'perfectly vertical'. anchor.derive opts every weapon into the silhouette-walking anchor sensor (PR #44) so the static-anchor pixel check doesn't reject slender blades.

judge.$comment: VLM judge is enabled for weapons. Enabling here costs Azure vision credits per variant, runs LOCAL ONLY (judge.ts refuses to run when env.CI is set), and rejects any variant where a 1-5 evaluator scores below 3.
